roleLines.R01: Keep the platform ready and its integrations running well, and manage users, permissions and reference data with confidence.
roleLines.R02: Stay on top of the portfolio’s performance, take the decisions awaiting your approval, and send update requests to the entities.
roleLines.R03: Follow your department’s projects, review the updates and requests that reach you, and take the decisions that move the work forward.
roleLines.R04: Lead your projects to completion, follow their progress, update their monthly achievements, and complete the tasks and requests due from you.
roleLines.R05: Stay on top of the entities’ responses on the projects assigned to you, and follow up late responses so the work keeps moving.
roleLines.R06: Stay informed about your department’s projects, and review their published data and figures for a clear picture of their performance.
roleLines.R07: See the full picture of the portfolio’s performance, and focus on the main risks and the decisions that need your attention.
roleLines.R08: Contribute to your entity’s projects, respond to AHDA’s update requests, and stay informed about your projects.
